newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products easier, except for fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products easier, except for fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products, except for fuel oil, weakened, traders said.
Gasoline eased with futures. Dealers estimate about 500,000 tonnes of Sept-loading gasoline has been sold transatlantic.
Naphtha was weaker, but little product was seen available and markets were quiet.
Gas oil dipped with futures, but traders said premiums were firm, supported by fairly tight supply and solid demand.
High sulphur barges were stronger, gaining up to $3 a tonne. Tight supplies allowed the market to shrug off weaker crude.
